The issuer demonstrates strong profitability with an EBIT margin of over 20% and a solid equity base, but exhibits significant leverage (Total Liabilities/Total Assets of 71%) and short-term liquidity pressure indicated by a working capital deficit (Current Ratio of 0.55). Balancing its substantial asset base ($17.3B) and solid earnings against a relatively low net margin (likely impacted by high interest expenses) and weak liquidity places the credit profile in the mid-to-low investment-grade category.

DECISION: BBB-
